pages.text: Based on Wuxing, you can handle magic with 5 elements of Reiryoku energy. Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, and Water element.
If there are seperate items for each element, only the Wood element ones will take place as examples.
Enter Kakuriyo Dimension and go to Cedar Forest to get a Weathered Rock.
Craft a Shide from Papers.
Use a Shide to a Wood element block to get a Wood Element Shide.

Craft a Wood Element Sacred Rock. $(br2)When a Wood element block is placed on the two-sheet-paper side, the rock transforms the block into 5 Reiyoku energy.$(br2)Right-click the Rock to see the amount of stored Reiryoku.

Ureful blocks for generating Reiryoku are...$(br)Wood Element：Suger Cane, Bamboo, Japanese Timber Bamboo$(br)Fire Element：Fire, Lantern Plant$(br)Earth Element：Dirt, Soul Sand$(br)Metal Element：Cobblestone$(br)Water Element：Cactus, Kelp, Snow

Place a Yomi Stone or a Cobbled Yomi Stone on top of a Chiseled Lacquer Log and wait when a required animal is nearby. The animal will be harmed and the Chiseled Lacquer Log turns into a Petrified Log with specific element Amber.$(br2)Restraints the animal with a Zabuton make it easier.
Wood：Chicken    Fire：Sheep$(br)Earth：Cow    Metal：Horse$(br)Water：Pig
Wood Element Amber is dropped from Petrified Log with Wood Element Amber.

If a Yomi Stone or a Cobbled Yomi Stone is placed on a Chiseled Lacquer Log without any animals nearby, it will finally become a Petrified Log.$(br2)You can craft Petrified Planks from Petrified Log, and neither the planks nor the log will be burnt by fire.$(br2)The appropriate tool is Pickaxe.

Craft a Visualization Goggles.$(br2)Even when Reiryoku is not being transported, you can see the path by which the Reiryoku is being transported if this is equipped on your head. $(br2)Without these glasses, it will be difficult to use magic equipments.

Craft a Wood Element Emitter and place on the side of a block to export Reiryoku.$(br2)It transports 1 Reiryoku per perticle if a transportation route is established.$(br2)The transportation will be stopped when it recieves a redstone signal.$(br2)Right-click the Emitter to see the amount of stored Reiryoku.
Craft some Sanbos.$(br2)Right-click to place a item on the Sanbo plate.$(br2)Right-click again to get the item back.$(br2)You can use a Hopper to place items.
Craft a Wood Element Altar.$(br2)Place 4 Sanbos on each side of the Altar, put ingredients on the Sanbos, and provite Reiryoku energy to the Altar to craft items.

Craft a Mirror.$(br2)By using this mirror, you can bend transportation routes of Reiryoku. $(br2)The path bends in the direction of the angle of reflection equal to the angle of incidence, as how light reflects on a mirror.$(br2)You should use Visualization Goggles to see the path.

Craft a Wood Element Onusa.$(br2)Onusa is suitable for storing Reiryoku energy, as it can both import and export Reiryoku.$(br2)The paths of Reiryoku transport can be branched and merged by using this as a relay point.

Thanks to the Wood Element Alter, it has become easier to craft Wood Element Amber. $(br2)Using a Alter, you can craft Amber from 4 Raw Urushi Bowl and 10 Reiryoku.$(br)You can also craft it from 4 Flint and 10 Reiryoku.
Craft some Wood Enhanced Jadeite.$(br2)They act as a kind of crafting material.
Wood Element Hokora is also a block that generates Reiryoku.$(br2)Import specific items using a Hopper to generates 5 reiryoku.
Specific item is...$(br2)Wood Element：Sweet Berries$(br)Fire Element：Wheat$(br)Earth Element：Rice Ear$(br)Metal Element：Green Onion$(br)Water Element：Soy Beans

Craft a Wood Element Magatama by Ritual Process.$(br2)By right-clicking on a Wood Element Onusa, Reiyoku will be transfered from the Onusa to the Magatama on hand.$(br2)When using items that consumes Reiryoku power, the player must have a Magatama in their inventory.
